card.name: Time words in historical narrative
card.fires_on: Time-related words such as "living", "today", "past month" and "since" in historical or dated prose. They mark a point in time relative to the story.

modes.label: Time-anchoring words
modes.description: Words like today, past, month or since that place an event in time in a historical account.
modes.example: Over 30,000 prisoners taken in Flanders during past<< month>>. Region above Valenciennes flooded by

modes.label: Superlative with living
modes.description: The word living after a superlative, as in the greatest living figure.
modes.example: acclaimed throughout Italy by the artistic and aristocratic world as the greatest<< living>> musical genius

card.writes: It seems to suppress words meaning "at that time" in Chinese and Korean, so it favors present or relative time over past reference.
card.plain: It fires on time words in history writing, such as "today", "past month" or "living", which place events in time.
